items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: Frank Sinatra. ... The Frank that I knew was instructive, in other words where he’d come in to work with the band, prepare for a show, he was ready to teach them to do it.

ctx.x: And who was the biggest name that you recall playing with at Miami Beach? Someone really well known?
